description: The ICUSTAYS table provides information on each patient's ICU stay within the MIMIC-III database. It links patients (`SUBJECT_ID`) to their hospital admissions (`HADM_ID`) and specific ICU stays (`ICUSTAY_ID`), including details about the database source (`DBSOURCE`), the first and last care units and wards the patient occupied, the admission and discharge times (`INTIME`, `OUTTIME`), and the length of stay (`LOS`). Each row represents a unique ICU stay.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the table.

columns.name: HADM_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a patient's hospital admission.

columns.name: ICUSTAY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a patient's stay in the ICU.

columns.name: DBSOURCE
columns.description: The database source where the data was originally recorded, such as 'carevue' or 'metavision'.

columns.name: FIRST_CAREUNIT
columns.description: The first care unit the patient was admitted to during their ICU stay (e.g., 'CSRU', 'MICU').

columns.name: LAST_CAREUNIT
columns.description: The last care unit the patient was in before discharge from the ICU (e.g., 'CSRU', 'MICU').

columns.name: FIRST_WARDID
columns.description: The ID of the first hospital ward the patient was admitted to.

columns.name: LAST_WARDID
columns.description: The ID of the last hospital ward the patient was in before discharge.

columns.name: INTIME
columns.description: The date and time the patient was admitted to the ICU.

columns.name: OUTTIME
columns.description: The date and time the patient was discharged from the ICU.

columns.name: LOS
columns.description: The length of stay in the ICU, in days.

relationships.reason: ICUSTAYS.SUBJECT_ID references PATIENTS.SUBJECT_ID. This represents the patient who stayed in the ICU.
ICUSTAYS.HADM_ID references ADMISSIONS.HADM_ID. This represents the hospital admission during which the ICU stay occurred.
